files_summary.tickets.json: Array of support tickets (ticket_id, subject, status, priority, requester, assignee, created, tags).
files_summary.comments.json: Array of ticket comments (comment_id, ticket_id, author, body, at).
files_summary.README.md: Schema, lifecycles and business rules of this benchmark's datastore.

tool_schemas.name: list_tickets
tool_schemas.description: Returns the tickets in Keystone Support Desk, optionally filtered by status, priority, and/or assignee, and includes the ticket fields needed to identify and triage each result. The request is refused if a provided status is not one of the supported values, or if any filter value is not a string. Filters that don’t match any tickets are allowed and simply return an empty list.

tool_schemas.name: get_ticket
tool_schemas.description: Returns the ticket identified by ticket_id along with its comments when the ticket exists. The request is refused if ticket_id is missing or not a string; if the ticket cannot be found, the service reports it as not found rather than returning a ticket. Requests are also refused when the caller is not allowed to view that ticket.
tool_schemas.implementation:
_DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0422000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0422000") else "/app/database")
def get_ticket(ticket_id):
    import json
    with open(__import__("os").path.join(_DB, 'tickets.json')) as f:
        ts = json.load(f)
    with open(__import__("os").path.join(_DB, 'comments.json')) as f:
        cs = json.load(f)
    t = next((x for x in ts if x.get('ticket_id') == ticket_id), None)
    if t is None:
        return {'found': False, 'ticket_id': ticket_id}
    out = dict(t)
    out['comments'] = [c for c in cs if c.get('ticket_id') == ticket_id]
    return out

tool_schemas.name: search_tickets
tool_schemas.description: Searches tickets by subject using a case-insensitive substring match on the provided query and returns the matching tickets. The request is refused if query is missing, not a string, or empty/only whitespace because a searchable term is required. Queries that are valid but match nothing return an empty result set.

tool_schemas.name: add_ticket_comment
tool_schemas.description: Adds a new comment to the specified ticket using the provided author and body, and returns the newly created comment. The request is refused if ticket_id, author, or body is missing or not a string, if the ticket does not exist, or if the ticket is in a state that does not accept new discussion. It is also refused when the author is not permitted to comment on that ticket.

tool_schemas.name: summarize_tickets
tool_schemas.description: Returns aggregate counts of tickets grouped by status and grouped by priority, optionally restricted to tickets matching the provided status, priority, and/or assignee filters. The request is refused if any filter value is not a string, if status or priority is provided with a value outside the supported enums, or if any unknown parameter is included. Valid filters that match no tickets return a summary with zero counts.

status.description: Optional status filter to restrict which tickets are included in the summary.

priority.description: Optional priority filter to restrict which tickets are included in the summary.

assignee.description: Optional assignee identifier/email filter to restrict which tickets are included in the summary.

metadata.name: Keystone Support Desk
metadata.description: A customer support ticketing service that lets teams track issues, search and retrieve tickets, add discussion comments, and generate ticket summaries.
